name: gloop-fixed-base-fork-holdout
sampling: random.Random(20260909).sample(sorted(original population minus six development tasks), 6); selection recorded before development results
model_tools: Shell, unified exec, web search, multi-agent, hooks, plugins, memories and host skill discovery disabled; read-only sandbox; reject any observed tool event. Built-in CLI preamble remains the same in both arms.
input: public instructions including appendices and starter source; reference implementations and full tests are not sent to the model
feedback: same unmodified upstream tests after implementation, output capped at 12000 UTF-8 bytes; one review stage may replace code if tests failed
retained_conversation: one persistent Codex session per task; subsequent stages receive only new instructions and test feedback, without redundant task/source repetition
gloop_artifact_handoff: real gloop runtime; design starts one persistent session; implement, review and PR draft each fork that immutable design session with only selected later artifacts; no accumulating conversation resume
ordering: paired tasks; alternate arm order, as in first pilot
primary_metrics: CLI-reported input tokens (already includes cached inputs; never add cached tokens again)
caveats: Custom workflow adaptation of six public Python exercises, not an official Aider leaderboard score
One run per task and arm; no statistical superiority claim
PR draft is local; no benchmark PRs are sent to GitHub
Codex ChatGPT subscription is used; calculated API list-price equivalents are not actual billing
Caches are measured, not claimed cold or identical
This two-arm pilot does not measure native subagent orchestration
Small exercise workflows do not establish results on large repository engineering tasks
Model alias fixed for this run; server-side snapshot ID is not exposed by this CLI
Provider changed from Claude to Codex after pre-inference HTTP 429; zero Claude solutions were generated, and all exclusions are retained
Prior gpt-5.4-mini results are historical, not a model-matched baseline; compare against the retained arm measured here with Luna.
provider: Codex CLI with existing ChatGPT authentication
budget_policy: At most 48 calls; stop if prior calculated API equivalent plus 0.20 USD reserve exceeds 6 USD; each call has 120s timeout. CLI has no dollar cap; reserve is not a hard per-call billing limit.
purpose: Independent confirmation after freezing session-fork implementation; one run per task and arm; no tuning on holdout
changes_under_test: compact lossless selected artifacts, no repeated task brief after design
provider session and token receipts persisted in runtime evidence
